description.value: The Mount Robson Visitor Centre is the official BC Parks Welcome Centre at the western entrance to Mount Robson Provincial Park, home to the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies at 3,954 m. Positioned along the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16), it anchors the 63 km Mount Robson Corridor and serves as the primary information gateway for the world-renowned Berg Lake Trail. Touring cyclists on the transcontinental Yellowhead route will find it a natural stop amid some of the most dramatic mountain scenery in British Columbia.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active Welcome Centre at Mount Robson Provincial Park's western entrance along the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16), a major cycling corridor. OSM tag toilets=yes supports washrooms; the website does not specifically mention bike parking, water refill, or Wi-Fi (OSM has internet_access=wlan but the rules require website confirmation for amenity claims). The website notes a restaurant, gift store, and gas station are 'nearby' but not at the visitor centre itself, so cafe on site remains null.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-566-4038) cannot be confirmed via the website, which only lists a general BC Parks contact number (1-800-689-9025); the OSM number may be a direct park line but is unverified.
OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no are not corroborated by the website; Wi-Fi marked null per rules.
No street address is available in OSM or on the fetched website pages.
OSM tag mobile_reception=no suggests cyclists should not rely on cell coverage at this location.
Community metadata reads 'Unknown / Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior'; the park is geographically on the BC/Alberta border near Valemount and may be miscategorized regionally.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active government visitor centre at the western entrance of one of BC's most popular parks, sitting directly on the Yellowhead Highway — a primary transcontinental cycling route. It is a clear and valuable stop for touring cyclists and belongs in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website notes that a restaurant, gift store, and gas station are 'nearby' the Welcome Centre — potentially useful for cyclists but not confirmed as on-site facilities. OSM also tags large_vehicles=yes, suggesting ample parking for vehicle-supported cycle tours.

wow_evidence: BC Parks welcome centre at the base of the classic full-frontal Robson view — the stop every Yellowhead rider makes; Berg Lake Trail gateway.
blurb: Welcome centre beneath the full face of Mount Robson; Berg Lake Trail information.
